name: convention-parameter-matchers
description: A row's entry globs may name the files of a directory and not a file beside it of the same stem: the parameter matcher in the params directory is a root, while a params file beside the directory is reported as a file nothing imports. The fixture assumes the analyzer carries a row named sveltekit for the package @sveltejs/kit, holding the installed version in its range, whose entry globs name the route files below src/routes and every file directly below src/params.
